scope: C03 original Blob ProcessAlg ROI/mask and ProcessOutput contract

sourceConfirmed: Caches the SDK Blob tool at this+0x15eb8 and sets the input image from module input +0x10.
Clears or resets the SDK region/assistant state before selecting the execution region.
When module mode this+0x28 equals 1, passes module input +0x118 directly as the SDK ROI/region object.
Otherwise uses GenerateMaskImage on the base input ROI/mask lists; on success passes the generated region image/object from input +0x118 and adds every enabled mask node from this+0x20.
Calls the SDK run method, then reads GetResult; null result throws 0xe0000315.
Writes result count, module status and measured algorithm time into the module output buffer.
Writes ModuStatus before reading the result and propagates nonzero output-writer errors.
Reads the SDK result again and writes BlobNum and TotalArea first.
Conditionally writes BinaryImage and BlobImage through the two module flags, then writes BlobStatus and per-blob arrays.

Per-blob output includes Perimeter, BlobRectX/Y/Width/Height, derived up-left and bottom-right coordinates, CenterX/Y, BoxWidth/Height, Angle, BlobAngle, AxisRatio, CentroidX/Y, Circularity and Rectangularity.
Each output field is written through the module output writer; a later field error can leave earlier fields already committed.

differentialImplication: The direct SDK C++ result 47/973202 is only a baseline for the SDK call with the same visible threshold values.

The wrapper has an additional ROI/region-image/mask path before Run, so VM 45/971486 cannot be attributed to SDK threshold math until the input +0x118 region object and enabled mask nodes are captured.
ProcessOutput copies and derives fields after the result exists; it cannot change BlobNum or TotalArea before the SDK result is produced.
unknowns: Exact vtable slot names for the decompiled region/reset calls remain ABI-sensitive; source confirms call order and arguments but not a stable symbolic slot mapping.
Native construction and pixel contents of the generated region image are still uncaptured.
